builds.title: Haraknin border tracker, ranger 1
builds.difficulty: ECL 8. 4 hell hound HD, 1 ranger HD and +3 level adjustment. CR 4 from the printed Haraknin formula.
builds.speed: 40 ft. hound form or 30 ft. in his usual Medium humanoid form.
skills: Move Silently +14 or +12 in chain shirt
traits: Lawful evil. BAB +5, grapple +8. Fortitude +9, Reflex +6, Will +4. Touch AC 12. Flat-footed AC 15 in hound form or 19 in his usual humanoid form. His chain shirt gives that form AC 21 and subtracts 2 from armor-affected skill checks. He needs to enter that form to use both hands for a scimitar.

Fire immunity. Take 50% extra damage from cold even if a save succeeds. Improved Initiative, Alertness and Track. Favored enemy animals grants +1 on the ranger’s qualifying checks and weapon damage against them. Ranger 1 has no spells.
actions: Hound form bite +8 melee, 1d8+4 piercing (×2). In humanoid form, masterwork scimitar +9 melee, 1d6+4 slashing if held in two hands (18–20/×2), or 1d6+3 if held in one hand.
Fire breath, standard action. In either form, a 30-ft. cone deals 1d4+1 fire, Reflex DC 15 half, and ignites combustibles. Roll 2d4 rounds before the next use.
Change Shape, move action, at will. Change between hound form and a Small, Medium or Large humanoid guise. Use the listed humanoid statistics for his normal Medium guise.

Command fiendish hounds, standard action at will, as greater command on hell hounds only. For this encounter use CL 5 and Will DC 12. This is separate from hell hounds never choosing to attack a Haraknin.
builds.tactics: Greet travelers in humanoid form, then switch to hound form to follow a missing scout by scent. If cornered, breathe fire first and use the faster form to break contact.

builds.title: Dark Creeper salvage guide, rogue 1
builds.difficulty: ECL 5 by the printed character paragraph. One rogue HD replaces the single racial HD, and level adjustment is +4.
skills: Pick Pocket +9 (Sleight of Hand in Fiend Folio)
traits: Chaotic neutral. Touch AC 16, flat-footed AC 14. BAB +0, grapple –1. Fortitude +2, Reflex +9, Will +2. Leather armor and Lightning Reflexes.

A qualifying melee sneak attack deals an extra 3d6, combining the 2d6 racial and 1d6 rogue bonuses. Only the rogue’s 1d6 applies to a qualifying ranged attack within 30 ft. Racial Evasion applies when a Reflex save would halve the damage.
Take a –2 morale penalty on attacks, saves, checks and damage in sunlight or daylight-equivalent illumination.
actions: Dagger +4 melee or +6 ranged, 1d4+3 piercing (19–20/×2, range increment 10 ft.).

Shadow Cloak, 3/day. Use a standard action and a 10-round duration for this encounter. Incoming attacks have 40% miss chance in shadows or darkness, or 20% in bright light. Sight that penetrates magical darkness bypasses it.
builds.tactics: Offer the party a route past the old trap doors first. If attacked, use Shadow Cloak and the closest side passage to escape. Nemm fights with the dagger if cornered.

builds.title: Red ethergaunt surveyor, wizard 1
builds.difficulty: ECL 13. 5 red ethergaunt HD, 1 wizard HD and +7 level adjustment. Innate wizard casting 9 stacks to caster level 10.
builds.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., total vision 40 ft. Silence does not affect total vision.
builds.languages: Khen-Zai by tendril movement. Understands Common and Draconic. Can communicate telepathically with its enslaved creature.
skills: Concentration +10 (+14 when casting defensively or while grappled)
traits: Neutral evil. Touch AC 12, flat-footed AC 14. BAB +3, grapple +5. Fortitude +2, Reflex +3, Will +8. Combat Casting and etherblade proficiency are racial bonus feats. Track and Weapon Focus (etherblade) are racial HD feats, Silent Spell is the 6-HD feat, and Wizard 1 grants Scribe Scroll. No familiar is present.
Silek chooses whether to ignore an applicable arcane spell of 2nd level or lower as if the caster failed against spell resistance. The ability leaves divine spells alone.

Caster level 10. Spell save DC 16 + original spell level. Spell slots by level 0–5 are 4/6/6/4/3/3. Silek cannot speak and prepares each listed spell silently in a slot one level above its original level. The four cantrip slots are unprepared.

Prepared by occupied slot level. 1st: detect magic ×2, read magic ×2, mage hand, prestidigitation. 2nd: mage armor, magic missile ×2, shield ×2, true strike. 3rd: invisibility, see invisibility, mirror image ×2. 4th: dispel magic, fireball, fly. 5th: dimension door, improved invisibility, Otiluke’s resilient sphere.
actions: Etherblade +6 melee, 1d10+3 slashing (×2), or +6 ranged touch, 1d6 force (40-ft. range increment). Silek’s expedition etherblade has 23 shots left.

Material Jaunt, standard action. Enter the Material Plane from the Ethereal Plane for up to 6 rounds. Return earlier by choice. Wait at least an hour on the Ethereal Plane before using this ability again.

Enslave, 3/day, one living target within 30 ft., Will DC 13, CL 16. Capacity one thrall. Active control permits telepathic commands and ends on a successful daily save or any termination listed in the profile.

Stupefying Gaze. On its turn open or close the mask as a free action. The open-mask gaze reaches 30 ft., Will DC 13. Failure deals 1d4 each to Int, Wis and Cha. A successful save grants immunity to Silek’s gaze for one day.

Silent fireball: standard action, 800-ft. range, 20-ft.-radius spread. 10d6 fire, Reflex DC 19 half. Silent magic missile: standard action, 200-ft. range, five missiles of 1d4+1 force each. Silent dimension door: standard action, range 800 ft. It ends Silek’s actions for the turn.
builds.tactics: Meet the characters already jaunted and keep the mask closed if they honor the survey boundary. On hostility, open the mask, use mirror image and withdraw by jaunt or dimension door. Silek carries the etherblade for threats on the survey route.

builds.title: Fensir night diviner, wizard 1
builds.difficulty: ECL 10. 4 giant HD, 1 wizard HD and +5 level adjustment. Innate Wizard 5 casting stacks to caster level 6.
builds.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, unlimited-range Sense Twin.
traits: Chaotic neutral. Touch AC 10, flat-footed AC 17. BAB +3, grapple +12. Fortitude +6, Reflex +2, Will +4. Space and reach 10 ft. Leather armor adds +2 AC and imposes a 10% failure chance on arcane spells with somatic components. Point Blank Shot, Precise Shot, racial Brew Potion and Wizard 1’s Scribe Scroll. No familiar is present.

Direct sun petrifies Ruun without a save. Sunbeam and sunburst also force a Fortitude save against petrification on top of their usual effects. Ruun senses sunrise or sunset up to an hour ahead and carries one pottery vial of the Fensir-only reversal potion.

Wizard casting at CL 6. 4/4/3/2 prepared slots by level 0–3. Spell save DC 11 + level. Cantrips: detect magic, ghost sound, mage hand, read magic. 1st: detect secret doors, magic missile ×2, obscuring mist. 2nd: darkness, detect thoughts, mirror image. 3rd: dispel magic, fireball.
actions: Throw rock +4 ranged, 1d6+5 bludgeoning (×2). Within 30 ft. treat it as +5 to hit, 1d6+6 damage. Range increment 120 ft., maximum five increments. No usual ranged penalty for a target in melee because of Precise Shot.
Catch rock, free action once per round if aware and prepared. Reflex DC 15 for a Small rock, 20 for Medium and 25 for Large, plus any applicable bonus on its attack roll.

Transmute rock to mud or mud to rock, at will as a standard action, CL 9. Use DC 13 where the 5th-level spell grants a save. The range is 190 ft. and the spell can affect up to eighteen 10-ft. cubes. Rock to mud changes natural unworked rock, to a maximum mud depth of 10 ft. A creature bogged down moves 5 ft. and takes –2 to AC and attacks. Mud to rock allows Reflex DC 13 to move clear before it hardens.

Magic missile: three missiles, each dealing 1d4+1 force, 160-ft. range. Fireball: 6d6 fire in a 20-ft.-radius spread from up to 640 ft., Reflex DC 14 half. Apply the separate arcane spell failure roll in his leather armor.
builds.tactics: Guide visitors under the rock shelf before sunrise. If a fight breaks out, use terrain magic to stop pursuit. Save fireball for a clear shot that misses the route home.

concepts.name: Vask Undercoal
concepts.role: A Haraknin ranger who tracks scouts across the slag fields.
concepts.motive: Recover a courier before the infernal toll wardens discover the loss.
concepts.hook: Vask offers to share his trail if the party brings back the courier alive.

concepts.name: Nemm Flinttoe
concepts.role: A salvage guide who can find the drain gates under a shuttered mine.
concepts.motive: Keep strangers from flooding the chambers where his neighbors sleep.
concepts.hook: Nemm will guide the party to the flooded chamber if they agree to turn off their lights first.

concepts.name: Silek-of-Nine
concepts.role: A red ethergaunt surveying the material side of a ruined checkpoint.
concepts.motive: Retrieve a map case dropped by an apprentice before a white overseer demands the next report.
concepts.hook: A thud at the checkpoint announces Silek’s arrival. It traces a case and a broken arrow in the dust, then points into the sealed vault.

concepts.name: Ruun Cliffseer
concepts.role: A night guide and diviner who reads runoff along a cliff trail.
concepts.motive: Find his twin’s last shelter before sunrise.
concepts.hook: Ruun offers to clear the slide blocking the trail if someone will check the exposed shelf for his twin.
